rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the substance H₂O.

example.english: I drink a lot of water every day.
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 dou1 jam2 hou2 do1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for watering plants or wetting something with poured or sprayed water.

example.english: I have to water the potted plants every morning.
example.traditional: 我每日朝早都要同啲盆栽淋水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 mui5 jat6 ziu1 zou2 dou1 jiu3 tung4 di1 pun4 zoi1 lam4 seoi2

rows.note: Use this for the eye-watering slice of the sense, such as when onions make your eyes water.

example.english: My eyes water whenever I cut onions.
example.traditional: 切洋蔥嗰陣，我成日流眼水。
example.jyutping: cit3 joeng4 cung1 go2 zan6 ngo5 seng4 jat6 lau4 ngaan5 seoi2

rows.note: Use 供水 for the provision of water as a public service or utility.

example.english: The water supply to this area was cut off this morning.
example.traditional: 呢區今日朝早停咗供水。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 gam1 jat6 ziu1 zou2 ting4 zo2 gung1 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when diluting a drink or other liquid by mixing in water.

example.english: This juice is too sweet, so we need to water it down before drinking.
example.traditional: 呢杯果汁太甜，要溝水先飲得落。
example.jyutping: ni1 bui1 gwo2 zap1 taai3 tim4 jiu3 gau1 seoi2 sin1 jam2 dak1 lok6

rows.note: Use 杯水 when ordering or referring to one serving or glass of water.

example.english: Please give me a glass of water.
example.jyutping: m4 goi1 bei2 bui1 seoi2 ngo5

rows.note: Use this specifically when giving an animal water to drink.

example.english: Remember to give the dog water before you leave.
example.traditional: 出門口之前，記住餵水畀隻狗。
example.jyutping: ceot1 mun4 hau2 zi1 cin4 gei3 zyu6 wai3 seoi2 bei2 zek3 gau2

rows.note: Use 礦泉水 specifically for mineral water rather than ordinary drinking water.

example.english: I want to buy a bottle of mineral water.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 maai5 zi1 kong3 cyun4 seoi2
